text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, oh dear. What was that just 
now...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...What was that, I wonder? It feels like 
I'm wrapped in warmth...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
How strange... I feel so deeply at ease, 
yet power is welling up from deep within 
me...!
